text:
The plate shows about 3-4 strips of cooked bacon. A strip of cooked bacon weighs roughly 8-12 g, but these look thick-cut, so I'll say about 12 g each.

The plate is roughly 20-22 cm wide, and the strips are about 12-15 cm long. That fits thick-cut strips, with some overlapping, so I count about 4 strips (one at the top, one on the left, one in the middle, one at the bottom right).

Four strips at about 12 g each gives about 48 g. Cooked bacon runs about 5 kcal/g, or roughly 540 kcal per 100 g, so 48 g comes to about 220-250 kcal.
